policy: Fresh context/process per task, saved local assets only. No DOM mutation or handler calls by driver. Scroll to locate controls, then use real click/key input. Require initial state, observed transition, readable visible outcome, no crash. Seek no replacement pages. Keep reference failures and timeouts. Visual match is separate: post-action RGBA equality, no tolerance. No engine edits before results. Do not pool with the original 20.
